purpose: Separate recoverable byte transport from one-shot scientific geometry interpretation.

parent_evidence.interpretation: R2 was invalidated by a pre-request schema mismatch. No source or geometry outcome was exposed.

selection.selection_rule: Retain the already frozen result-blind lexicographic minimum of the fixed official run universe floor3_1, floor3_2, floor3_3.

allowed: HEAD to the exact canonical URL for transport metadata.
GET and byte-range continuation requests to the exact canonical URL only.
Automatic retry or resume after transport interruption, provided the URL, file ID, ETag, Last-Modified, expected bytes, and official MD5 do not change.
Streaming writes plus byte count, MD5, and SHA-256 calculation.
forbidden: Opening ZIP central-directory or members before complete byte and official-MD5 verification.
Mirrors, repacks, floor3_2, floor3_3, CoRBS, KITTI-360, or another source as transport fallback.
Using retry count, transfer speed, partial bytes, or headers to change candidate selection.
RGB, depth, pose, geometry, or RCLE algorithm access before the later geometry claim.
transport_contract.cache_finalization: Rename the .part file to the immutable cache name only after exact bytes and official MD5 match. Record local SHA-256 and transport receipt.

required_before_geometry_claim: frozen R3 geometry implementation and independent validator
empty R3 geometry claim and output paths
